messages:
Maya (CSM): Kicking off NewMarket 14-day pilot. Scope: semantic search + chat for sales playbooks. Need low latency and clear audit logs.
Evan (NewMarket PM): I'm the PM; Priya is infra lead. We'll provide ~9k docs and a canonical eval set of 18 queries.
Roh (Solutions): Proposed success criteria: ingest 9k docs; median retrieval relevance >=0.7; p95 chat latency <550ms; adoption by 3 reps with >=70% spot-check satisfaction.
Priya (NewMarket Infra): We require VPC peering, IP allowlist, and SAML SSO for admin. Can provide CIDR + certs by EOD day1.
Sam (Enablement): I'll schedule an admin ops session (Day2) and a rep training (Day6). Confirm attendees please.
Maya (CSM): Timeline draft: Day0 creds; Day1 networking; Day2 ingest prep + admin ops; Day3-5 ingest & index; Day6 training; Day7-9 tune + spot-check; Day10 exec demo; Day11-14 iterate/go-no-go.
Evan (NewMarket PM): Attendees: reps Jonah, Priya, and Li. Procurement asked for a pilot cost ballpark.
Roh (Solutions): Ingest format: JSONL {id, text, metadata}. Will post example CLI and a small scoring harness.
Maya (CSM): Action items: Priya: CIDR + SAML metadata (day1). Roh: ingest example + scoring harness (day2). Sam: invites (day2). Finance: cost calc (day3).
Onboard Bot: Onboarding board created: https://redwood.company/onboard/newmarket-pilot (team-only).
Maya (CSM): Risk flags: renewal risk if adoption <50% or if relevance <0.6 after tuning. Scheduling Day8 mid-pilot check-in. Post blockers here.
